ValidationRule.description: Requires Justification when submitting for approval.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Submit_for_Approval__c = true, ISBLANK(Justification__c), OR( Quoted_Price__c > 500000, Discount_Percentage__c > 0.10 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must provide a Justification before submitting for high-value or high-discount approval.
